title: Safe-delete refusal tests depend on runner disk space: the free-space reserve refuses first and masks the expected refusal
description:
**Seen:** BalazsOrg/dydo PR 352 (<issue id="510e86f3-e7da-416a-ae09-7bdd96252a9e" label="DYD-1168" href="https://linear.app/bodnar-balazs/issue/DYD-1168/safe-delete-windows-runs-close-to-its-30-minute-limit-23m53s-for-335" />), head 08edb6db, run 44179826689, job 134380844309, `safe-delete-windows`: 334 of 335 passed, 1 failed. The PR only changes the CI workflow, so it didn't cause this.

`SafeDeleteInputsTests.ChangedCommonInput_RetainsTargetEvenWhenStatusIsUnchanged(name: "attributes", checkpoint: "before-worktree-delete", present: False)` at `SafeDeleteInputsTests.cs:28`: `Assert.Contains() Failure`. The output began `Space C:\Users\runneradmin\AppData\Local\…` (the free-space reserve refusal, <issue id="74cc2ed5-a670-438d-b02c-64ad16736d41" label="DYD-1107" href="https://linear.app/bodnar-balazs/issue/DYD-1107/safe-delete-spec-define-a-free-space-reserve-before-archiving" />'s ruling: max(5 GiB, 10%)). The expected `proof input` refusal never appeared. Its sibling cases passed on the same run.

**Cause:** the hosted Windows runner's free space dipped below the reserve, so the reserve check refused before the proof-input check this test asserts. The test depends on runner disk space.

**Fix:** refusal tests that don't test the reserve set a low reserve in their fixture (the reserve is configurable in `dydo.json` per the <issue id="4ffab092-4f99-4b5c-8ddb-3e66d1419a52" label="DYD-1029" href="https://linear.app/bodnar-balazs/issue/DYD-1029/a-safe-delete-dydo-command-archive-a-branch-or-worktree-for-30-days" /> ruling), so the refusal under test is the first one reached. Keep a dedicated test for the reserve itself. Red proof: force the fixture's free space under the default reserve and show the test fails before the fix and passes after.

Filed by the dydo 4.0.0 admiral (requested model: claude-opus-5-5).

Acceptance contract (commission 2026-11-17)

* Branch <issue id="0d106e46-f6bd-4da8-b7e9-d26543be433b" label="DYD-1172" href="https://linear.app/bodnar-balazs/issue/DYD-1172/safe-delete-refusal-tests-depend-on-runner-disk-space-the-free-space" />-safe-delete-disk-independent from live feature/dydo-4-0-0 ed2c5f06eac5e950deabb0e14ad4945a3c27aaa8; PR targets that feature only. Isolated T3 checkout /home/balazs/.t3/worktrees/DynaDocs/t3-af19064a-6d143b41bd5a572a, initially clean.
* Owned paths: DynaDocs.Tests/Integration/SafeDelete\*.cs and DynaDocs.Tests/Steps/SafeDeleteSteps.cs only as fixture reach requires; durable proof under dydo/project/changelog/2026/2026-11-17/<issue id="0d106e46-f6bd-4da8-b7e9-d26543be433b" label="DYD-1172" href="https://linear.app/bodnar-balazs/issue/DYD-1172/safe-delete-refusal-tests-depend-on-runner-disk-space-the-free-space" />/. No production change or weakened assertions.
* Every non-reserve refusal fixture sets a low reserve through supported configuration/existing test hook. Dedicated reserve refusal retained. RED forced space below default reserve fails an affected assertion before, passes after.
* Atomic test infrastructure intent; no new Gherkin journey. Existing safe-delete scenarios retained. No lanes/spec review needed.
* Exact gates: nonzero discovery and affected safe-delete Light, applicable .NET static and ticket-scoped coverage through current facade; captain reruns writer RED/GREEN recipe. Final PR's own hosted safe-delete-windows and Linux Actions pass; no dytest-ci suite. Mutation UNAVAILABLE inherited <issue id="6c8c77ec-e009-41bb-a198-4a9b0c00c01c" label="DYD-103" href="https://linear.app/bodnar-balazs/issue/DYD-103/implement-isolated-mutation-assurance-for-c-python-and-javascript" />, never PASS.
* One GPT-6.1 sol high writer; one fresh Claude claude-opus-5-5 high reviewer, DR058 grading (live commission replaces default two-seat review).
* Offer non-draft exact-head PASS; merge only Actions green, no dytest-ci, pinned live-head/live-base dydo merge dry-run exit 0, then Merge chain. Any dydo merge refusal parks verbatim. Delegated captain returns PR open for admiral watch while pending.
